stateroomsShortDescription.text: Relax in your luxurious home on the high seas inspired by the adventures of Frozen, Aladdin, Thor and The Little Mermaid. Moana fans will love the special selection of staterooms overlooking the open oasis of Wayfinder Bay. For added comfort, choose a room with a private balcony or secondary bedroom. Concierge Guests also enjoy access to personalized services, benefits and exclusive spaces. Images shown on this page are artist renderings and may not reflect the final product.

shortDescription.text: For a Disney Cruise experience like no other, select an upscale Concierge-level suite situated on our uppermost passenger decks. Here, you’ll feel on top of the world as you sail to new worlds, all while being pampered with first-class amenities and exceptional service. With separate living rooms and bedrooms, a sprawling private verandah and special touches like a well-stocked library of movies, we’ve thought of everything you could need or want—and more.

With separate living rooms and bedrooms, a sprawling private verandah and special touches like a well-stocked library of movies, we’ve thought of everything you could need or want—and more.
